AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – USE OF MANIFOLD GAUGE SET

USE OF MANIFOLD GAUGE SET
MANIFOLD GAUGE SET INSTALLATION

1. CONNECT CHARGING HOSES TO MANIFOLD GAUGE SET
Tighten the nuts by hand.
CAUTION: Do not connect the wrong hoses.
2. CONNECT QUICK CONNECTORS TO CHARGING HOSES
Tighten the nuts by hand.
3. CLOSE BOTH HAND VALVES OF MANIFOLD GAUGE SET
4. REMOVE CAPS FROM SERVICE VALVES ON REFRIGERANT LINE

Low Pressure Charging Hose
High Pressure Charging Hose

N08541

5. CONNECT QUICK CONNECTORS TO SERVICE VALVES
HINT: Push the quick connector onto the service valve, then slide the sleeve of the quick connector downward to lock it.

Sleeve

N04342

MANIFOLD GAUGE SET REMOVAL

1. CLOSE BOTH HAND VALVES OF MANIFOLD GAUGE SET
2. DISCONNECT QUICK CONNECTORS FROM SERVICE VALVES ON REFRIGERANT LINE
HINT: Slide the sleeve of the quick connector upward to unlock the connector and remove it from the service valve.
3. INSTALL CAPS TO SERVICE VALVES ON REFRIGERANT LINE

N06553
